historical_reviews.deepseek: The range-like command does not prove five rows or lower-bank position, and the PDB temperature oracle is unrelated.

historical_reviews.history: Duplicate row 1886 is a six-sensor PDB PSU temperature family, not lower fan telemetry.
historical_reviews.v3_1: LOWER identifies a distinct chassis bank while F identifies one vendor-defined member of each numbered assembly. Both axes must be proven; evidence from an upper fan, paired R channel or PDB sensor is not equivalent.

original_test_intent: Verify all expected LOWER_FAN1 through LOWER_FAN5 F-position resources in BMC Web, including lower-bank assembly/position, RPM, units, health, thresholds, freshness and range against the approved cooling SPEC.
original_method: Resolve chassis bank and F/R semantics; enumerate five explicit lower-F members in the protected UI; bind each to a physical lower fan assembly and R partner; capture page context; compare complete fields to the SPEC; optionally correlate backend telemetry; preserve logs and make no fan changes.
manual_activity: A platform reviewer proves lower-bank/F-position semantics, confirms five physical mappings and validates the complete Web evidence against the correct cooling SPEC.
safety_requirements: Do not change fan duty/curves, cooling, power or firmware
Do not infer bank or suffix semantics
agent_execution_scope: Verify target and lower fan topology
Map each to assembly and R partner
Compare RPM, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range
engineer_actions: Approve bank/F-R semantics and pair map
Visually confirm all lower F rows
Resolve missing, duplicate, stale or ambiguous positions

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A literal `LOWER_FAN1~5_F` request does not expand five resources; truncated SDR and PDB temperature output cannot prove lower-F coverage.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Capture five explicit lower-F UI resources and topology; use full exact-name backend reads only as same-source corroboration.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The Web/SPEC check and 3/3-minute estimate remain; generic clear and PDB-temperature substitution are excluded.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Key evidence by lower-bank physical assembly plus F channel, then join its R partner and complete fresh Web fields.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds two-dimensional bank/channel identity and completeness.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Number-only or suffix-only matching can silently map an upper or partner tachometer to the wrong lower assembly.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The geometric meaning of lower and F must be taken from the chassis service map, not assumed from airflow direction.

project_override_considerations: Define lower-bank membership, F meaning, five assemblies and R pairs. The following lower-R case and duplicate PDB temperature row remain separate.
expected_evidence: Target/firmware/Web route and lower-bank topology with F/R definition
Protected UI captures for all lower-F members and page context
Per-member assembly/pair, RPM, units, health, thresholds, timestamp and range result

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Web procedure and SPEC criterion consistently target lower F-position fans. Generic clear and PDB temperature output are method/reference defects.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Bank topology, suffix semantics, SPEC and UI are identifiable package inputs; execution becomes BLOCKED only if the mapping stays ambiguous.

review_improvement: Requires both chassis-bank and rotor-channel identity, preventing neighboring upper/R fan data or PDB temperatures from satisfying this case.
independent_technical_reasoning: Large chassis can reuse fan numbers across upper and lower banks, and paired tach channels can share an assembly number. Therefore `1~5_F` is not a unique physical identity until combined with the lower-bank map; validating only speed values could accept the wrong five channels wholesale.
